title: Hayagriva YAML export crashes on `@performance` entries: `No enum constant StandardEntryType.Performance`
body:
### JabRef version

Latest development branch build (please note build date below)

### Operating system

Windows

### Details on version and operating system

Windows 11. Development build 2026-10-28. The same crash was reproduced in 5.15, in 6.0-beta.1

### Checked with the [latest development build](https://builds.jabref.org/main/) (copy version output from About dialog)

- [x] I made a backup of my libraries before testing the latest development version.
- [x] I have tested the latest development version and the problem persists

### Steps to reproduce the behaviour

1. Open a library containing a `@performance` entry, for example:

```bibtex
@performance{Example2024Performance,
  title      = {Example Performance Title},
  author     = {Example Author},
  date       = {2024-09-12},
  venue      = {Example Venue},
  location   = {Example City},
  eventtitle = {Example Event},
  type       = {Spoken Word Performance},
  url        = {https://example.org/event}
}
```

2. Select the entry and export as Hayagriva YAML.


### Appendix

Exporting a library to Hayagriva YAML fails whenever the library contains a `@performance` entry, and the whole export aborts. The exporter maps the entry type through `StandardEntryType.valueOf("Performance")`, but that enum has no `Performance` constant, so a single `@performance` entry blocks an otherwise normal library export.

The export should complete, with the entry written as `type: performance`. Hayagriva's format defines `performance` as a valid entry type, a live artistic performance, and `@performance` is also a type in BibLaTeX's data model, so this is a straightforward mapping — not a crash, and not a silent conversion to `misc`.

The same crash was reproduced in 5.15, in 6.0-beta.1, and in the latest development build on 28 October 2026, in a fresh two-entry test library containing only one `@performance` entry and one ordinary `@article` entry.

```
java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: No enum constant org.jabref.model.entry.types.StandardEntryType.Performance
	at java.base/java.lang.Enum.valueOf(Enum.java:293)
	at org.jabref.jablib/org.jabref.model.entry.types.StandardEntryType.valueOf(StandardEntryType.java:9)
	at org.jabref.jablib/org.jabref.logic.layout.format.HayagrivaType.format(HayagrivaType.java:10)
	at org.jabref.jablib/org.jabref.logic.layout.LayoutEntry.handleOptionField(LayoutEntry.java:255)
	at org.jabref.jablib/org.jabref.logic.layout.LayoutEntry.doLayout(LayoutEntry.java:218)
	at org.jabref.jablib/org.jabref.logic.layout.LayoutEntry.handleFieldOrGroupStart(LayoutEntry.java:308)
	at org.jabref.jablib/org.jabref.logic.layout.LayoutEntry.doLayout(LayoutEntry.java:216)
	at org.jabref.jablib/org.jabref.logic.layout.Layout.doLayout(Layout.java:102)
	at org.jabref.jablib/org.jabref.logic.exporter.TemplateExporter.export(TemplateExporter.java:255)
	at org.jabref/org.jabref.gui.exporter.ExportCommand.lambda$export$2(ExportCommand.java:115)
	at org.jabref.jablib/org.jabref.logic.util.BackgroundTask$1.call(BackgroundTask.java:69)
	at org.jabref/org.jabref.gui.util.UiTaskExecutor$1.call(UiTaskExecutor.java:224)
	at javafx.graphics@27/javafx.concurrent.Task$TaskCallable.call(Task.java:1407)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.FutureTask.run(FutureTask.java:328)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.Executors$RunnableAdapter.call(Executors.java:545)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.FutureTask.run(FutureTask.java:328)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor.runWorker(ThreadPoolExecutor.java:1090)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor$Worker.run(ThreadPoolExecutor.java:614)
	at java.base/java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:1474)
```

Related, but not the same bug: #10382 (original Hayagriva export feature) and #10596 (parent field dropped in Hayagriva export, fixed in 5.12).
